action.zh: 學校考生由學校代為報名；自修生須於 10 月 7 日前自行網上報名，並於 10 月 14 日前繳費。
action.en: School candidates are entered by their school. Private candidates register online by 7 Oct and pay by 14 Oct.

missed.zh: 自修生於 10 月 15–20 日逾期繳費，須另付 HK$321。
missed.en: Private candidates paying late (15–20 Oct) pay an extra HK$321.

action.zh: 開設及啟動帳戶、繳交申請費，並遞交最多 20 個課程選擇。
action.en: Create and activate your account, pay the fee and submit up to 20 programme choices.

missed.zh: 12 月 2 日後只能逾期申請，費用增至 HK$1,000。
missed.en: After 2 Dec you can only apply late, for HK$1,000.

title.zh: UCAS 截止（牛津、劍橋及大部分醫科）
title.en: UCAS deadline: Oxford, Cambridge and most medicine

action.zh: 計劃報讀英國牛劍或醫科、牙科、獸醫的同學須於當日前遞交。
action.en: Submit by today if you are applying to Oxford, Cambridge or most medicine, dentistry or veterinary courses.

title.zh: E-APP 首輪申請（副學位及自資學士）
title.en: E-APP main round (sub-degrees and self-financed degrees)

action.zh: 經 E-APP 報讀非聯招的副學士、高級文憑及自資學士，最多 20 個課程。
action.en: Apply to non-JUPAS associate degrees, higher diplomas and self-financed degrees through E-APP, up to 20 programmes.

fee.en: Each institution sets its own application fee

action.zh: 錯過 12 月 2 日的同學，仍可在此期間遞交申請。
action.en: If you missed 2 Dec, you can still apply in this window.

missed.zh: 1 月 13 日後不再接受任何申請。
missed.en: No applications are accepted after 13 Jan.

fee.zh: HK$1,000（申請費 HK$500＋逾期附加費 HK$500）

title.zh: UCAS 截止（其他英國課程）
title.en: UCAS deadline: all other UK courses

action.zh: 牛劍及醫科以外的英國學士課程，須於當日前遞交。
action.en: Submit applications for all other UK undergraduate courses by today.

title.zh: 遞交比賽／活動經驗及成就（OEA）

action.zh: 在 JUPAS 帳戶填寫比賽、活動及獎項，最多 10 項。
action.en: Enter competitions, activities and awards in your JUPAS account.

missed.zh: 截止後不接受遞交或修改。
missed.en: No submissions or changes are accepted after the deadline.

title.zh: 更新課程選擇（放榜前）及 SLP 截止
title.en: Update choices before results; SLP deadline

action.zh: 可增刪或調動次序，最多 20 個；5 月 26 日的名單就是放榜前的定案。同日亦是學生學習概覽（SLP）截止。
action.en: Add, drop or reorder up to 20 choices; the list at 26 May is what counts before results. The Student Learning Profile (SLP) is also due.

action.zh: 由學校遞交。宜及早與班主任或升學老師傾談你的志向和強項。
action.en: Your school submits it. Talk to your class or careers teacher early about your goals and strengths.

action.zh: 由學校遞交，學生不能自行申請。只有 5 月 26 日時仍在 Band A 的課程才獲考慮。
action.en: Submitted by the school, not the student. Only choices still in Band A on 26 May are considered.

action.zh: 按准考證編排的場次應考。
action.en: Attend your assigned session.

action.zh: 核心科：中文 4 月 8 日、英文 4 月 9–10 日、數學 4 月 12 日、公民 4 月 13 日。英語文學、科技與生活、體育及音樂的日期於 11 月初確定。
action.en: Core: Chinese 8 Apr, English 9–10 Apr, Maths 12 Apr, CSD 13 Apr. Literature in English, Technology & Living, PE and Music are confirmed in early November.

action.zh: 在 JUPAS 帳戶完成第 5 步，確認應考年份。這是必須完成的步驟。
action.en: Complete Step 5 in your JUPAS account to confirm your exam year(s). This step is mandatory.

action.zh: 首輪錯過或想多報幾個課程，可在次輪申請。
action.en: Apply here if you missed the main round or want to add programmes.

action.zh: 回校領取成績，先見升學老師，再決定是否修改課程選擇。
action.en: Collect results at school and see your careers teacher before changing any choices.

action.zh: 7 月 14 日下午 3 時至 16 日下午 3 時。可免費修改一次：新增或替換最多 5 個課程，並可調動次序或刪除。不作修改即沿用 5 月 26 日的名單。
action.en: 3pm 14 Jul to 3pm 16 Jul. One free change: add or replace up to 5 programmes, reorder or delete. If you do nothing, the 26 May list stands.

missed.zh: 限期後不能再修改。院校於 7 月 14–16 日不提供諮詢，有疑問須於 13 日前查詢。
missed.en: No changes after the deadline. Institutions give no advice on 14–16 Jul, so ask by 13 Jul.

action.zh: 上午 9 時登入 JUPAS 查看結果。每人最多只獲一個取錄。
action.en: Log in at 9am to see your result. You receive at most one offer.

title.en: Accept your offer: pay the acceptance fee

action.zh: 8 月 5 日下午 5 時前繳費，再按院校安排註冊。
action.en: Pay by 5pm on 5 Aug, then register as your institution instructs.

missed.zh: 不繳費即作放棄論，而且同一學年不會再獲 JUPAS 考慮，亦不能參加補選。
missed.en: Not paying means you decline the offer and will not be considered again through JUPAS this year, including the Clearing Round.

action.zh: 2027 年覆核申請日期未公布；2026 年是放榜後約一星期內經學校申請。
action.en: The 2027 remark application window is not yet published; in 2026 it was within about a week after results, through schools.

action.zh: 只適用於覆核後成績提升的同學：上午 9 時至下午 5 時提出，並可免費修改課程選擇一次。
action.en: Only if remarking raised your grades: submit between 9am and 5pm, with one free change of choices.

action.zh: 如獲新取錄，須即日下午 5 時前繳交留位費；新取錄會取代原有正式遴選取錄。
action.en: If you get a new offer, pay by 5pm the same day; it replaces your Main Round offer.

action.zh: 只適用於正式遴選未獲取錄的同學，由原有課程選擇中自動考慮。獲取錄須即日繳費及註冊。
action.en: Only for applicants without a Main Round offer, considered automatically from existing choices. Pay and register the same day if you get one.

missed.zh: 不繳費或不註冊即作放棄論。
missed.en: Not paying or not registering counts as declining.

apply.zh: 以各次模擬試的平均分定位，不要用最好的一次。例如模擬試介乎 24–28 分，就按 25–26 分揀選。
apply.en: Plan from your average mock score, not your best. If mocks range 24–28, plan around 25–26.

apply.zh: Band A 採用「搏前穩後」：A1、A2 放預計分數接近往年 LQ 的課程，A3 放一個分數達往年中位數再高約 5% 的課程。
apply.en: Order Band A from ambitious to safe: A1 and A2 near last year's LQ, A3 at or about 5% above last year's median.

apply.zh: 需要面試的課程宜放 Band A，部分課程只會邀請 Band A 申請人面試。
apply.en: Put programmes with interviews in Band A; some only interview Band A applicants.

apply.zh: 逐個課程核對指定科目及計分比重；學額少於 20 個的課程，收生分數每年波動較大。
apply.en: Check each programme's required subjects and weightings; small programmes (under 20 places) swing more year to year.

apply.zh: 不要只看名氣或收生分數揀科，先問自己是否喜歡該學科的內容。
apply.en: Don't pick by prestige or cut-off alone; check you actually like what the programme teaches.

apply.zh: 考慮內地或台灣升學的同學，須在 12 月前完成報名，放榜後才決定已經太遲。
apply.en: If Mainland or Taiwan study is an option, register before December; deciding after results is too late.

prepare.zh: 盡早完成 OEA 和 SLP。分數相近時，這些資料可能成為取捨依據。
prepare.en: Finish your OEA and SLP early; they can decide close cases.

prepare.zh: 及早與升學老師傾談學校評核報告及校長推薦。
prepare.en: Talk to your careers teacher early about the school reference and principal nomination.

prepare.zh: 準備面試：熟讀課程結構，準備「為何選讀此課程」的答案；小組討論是最常見的形式。
prepare.en: Prepare for interviews: know the programme structure and your 'why this programme' answer; group discussion is the most common format.

prepare.zh: 5 月 26 日前定好課程選擇，之後直至放榜都不能再改。
prepare.en: Finalise your choices by 26 May; nothing can change until results.

exam.zh: 考試期間不要作升學決定，專心應考。
exam.en: Don't make application decisions during exams.

exam.zh: 把 JUPAS、E-APP 等帳戶登入資料及截止日期記錄在同一處。
exam.en: Keep JUPAS, E-APP and other logins and deadlines in one place.

exam.zh: 6 月 16 日前在 JUPAS 確認考試年份，這一步不可遺漏。
exam.en: Confirm your exam year in JUPAS by 16 Jun; it is mandatory.

results.zh: 放榜前按 18、22、26 分等情況，預先擬定改選方案。
results.en: Before results day, draft change plans for different outcomes, e.g. 18, 22 and 26 points.

results.zh: 預備 HK$5,000 及設定轉數快，並核對身份證號碼，以便日後繳交留位費。
results.en: Have HK$5,000 ready, set up FPS and double-check your HKID number for the deposit.

results.zh: 放榜當日帶備身份證、成績通知書、中四至中六成績表及 SLP／OEA 副本。
results.en: On results day bring your HKID, results slip, S4–S6 report cards and copies of your SLP/OEA.

results.zh: 先見升學老師，再修改課程選擇；按實際成績重新計算各課程的比重分。
results.en: See your careers teacher before changing choices, and recalculate weighted scores with your real results.

results.zh: 以「覆核不會成功」為前提作決定，覆核結果要到 8 月才公布。
results.en: Decide as if remarking won't help; remark results only come out in August.

results.zh: 只作針對性修改，並在 A3 保留一個有把握的選擇。
results.en: Make targeted changes only and keep a safe choice at A3.

results.zh: 放榜後才加入需面試的課程，未必會獲邀面試。
results.en: Adding an interview programme after results does not guarantee an interview.

results.zh: 不要在最後一刻才遞交；遞交後保存確認頁，並留意電郵及短訊通知。
results.en: Don't submit at the last minute; save the confirmation page and check your email and SMS.

offer.zh: 正式遴選每人最多一個取錄。可以接受的話，須按時繳費及註冊。
offer.en: You get at most one Main Round offer. If it is acceptable, pay and register on time.

offer.zh: 拒絕取錄後，同一學年不會再獲 JUPAS 考慮，不能「等補選」。
offer.en: Declining ends JUPAS for the year; you cannot wait for Clearing instead.

offer.zh: 留位費 HK$5,000 一般不獲退還。
offer.en: The HK$5,000 acceptance fee is generally non-refundable.

offer.zh: 覆核後成績提升，可於 8 月 12 日申請重新審核，已繳留位費可轉用。
offer.en: If remarking raises your grades, request reconsideration on 12 Aug; the fee you paid carries over.

offer.zh: 正式遴選未獲取錄者會自動進入補選；在此之前，先保留已繳留位費的副學位學額。
offer.en: Applicants without an offer go into Clearing automatically; keep any sub-degree place you have secured until then.

title.zh: E-APP（副學士、高級文憑、自資學士）
title.en: E-APP (associate degrees, higher diplomas, self-financed degrees)

when.en: Main round 3 Dec 2026–18 May 2027; second round 21 May–6 Jul 2027

note.zh: 與 JUPAS 分開，可同時申請。各院校自訂申請費。
note.en: Separate from JUPAS; you can use both. Each institution sets its own fee.

title.zh: 內地高校招收香港中學文憑考試學生計劃（免試）

when.en: 2027/28 not yet published; 2026/27 registration was 1–31 Dec 2025

note.zh: 在考試前報名，放榜後才決定已經太遲。最低要求為 332A。
note.en: Register before the exam; deciding after results is too late. Minimum requirement 332A.

title.zh: 台灣 港澳生聯合招生
title.en: Taiwan joint admission for Hong Kong students

when.zh: 2027 年未公布；2026 年個人申請為 2025年11月1日–12月15日，聯合分發為 2026年2月1日–3月15日
when.en: 2027 not yet published; for 2026, individual applications ran 1 Nov–15 Dec 2025 and joint distribution 1 Feb–15 Mar 2026

note.en: Also requires registration before the exam.

when.zh: 牛劍及醫科 2026年10月15日；其他課程 2027年1月13日
when.en: Oxbridge and medicine 15 Oct 2026; other courses 13 Jan 2027

note.zh: 持 BN(O) 簽證未獲定居身分者，須繳付海外生學費。
note.en: BN(O) visa holders without settled status pay international fees.

title.zh: VTC 高級文憑及基礎課程
title.en: VTC higher diplomas and foundation diploma

when.zh: 2027/28 報名資料將於 2026 年 11 月公布
when.en: 2027/28 application details will be announced in November 2026

note.zh: 高級文憑要求中英文 2 級及另外三科 2 級。
note.en: Higher Diploma requires Chinese 2, English 2 and three more subjects at Level 2.

title.zh: 應用教育文憑（DAE，取代毅進）
title.en: Diploma of Applied Education (DAE, replaces Yi Jin)

note.zh: 完成後等同文憑試五科 2 級（包括中英文），可升讀副學位。
note.en: Equivalent to five HKDSE subjects at Level 2 including Chinese and English, for sub-degree entry.

myth.zh: 拒絕正式遴選的取錄，可以等補選再搏更好的課程。
myth.en: I can decline my Main Round offer and wait for a better one in Clearing.

fact.zh: 正式遴選的取錄不論接受與否，同一學年都不會再獲 JUPAS 考慮。補選只給完全未獲取錄的申請人。
fact.en: Once you get a Main Round offer, accepted or not, JUPAS will not consider you again that year. Clearing is only for applicants with no offer.

myth.zh: HK$5,000 留位費可以退，或者會撥作學費。
myth.en: The HK$5,000 fee is refundable or goes towards tuition.

fact.zh: 留位費不予退還，只有重複繳費等極少數情況例外。
fact.en: It is non-refundable, except in a few cases such as duplicate payment.

myth.en: I can change my choices freely after results.

fact.zh: 只有 7 月 14–16 日一次免費修改，最多新增或替換 5 個課程；再改一次須付 HK$250。
fact.en: You get one free change on 14–16 Jul, adding or replacing up to 5 programmes; a second change costs HK$250.

myth.zh: 放榜後加入需面試的課程，一定會獲邀面試。
myth.en: Adding an interview programme after results guarantees an interview.

fact.zh: 不一定。部分課程只面試 Band A 申請人，或只取錄放榜前已面試的申請人。
fact.en: Not guaranteed. Some programmes only interview Band A applicants, or only admit those interviewed before results.

myth.zh: 校長推薦可以放榜後才加入 Band A。
myth.en: I can move a programme into Band A after results for my principal nomination.

fact.zh: 校長推薦只考慮 5 月 26 日時已在 Band A 的課程。
fact.en: Nominations only count for programmes in Band A as at 26 May.

myth.zh: 內地及台灣升學可以放榜後才考慮。
myth.en: Mainland and Taiwan study can wait until after results.

fact.zh: 兩者都要在考試前（約 11 至 12 月）報名。
fact.en: Both require registration before the exam, around November to December.

myth.zh: 重考後舊成績會被取代。
myth.en: Retaking the DSE wipes out my old results.

fact.zh: 院校會看到所有年份的成績，部分課程對合併成績或重考生另有扣分或限制。
fact.en: Institutions see all your results; some programmes deduct marks for combined results or restrict repeaters.

label.zh: JUPAS 2027 重要日期及截止日期
JUPAS 放榜後修改課程選擇
考評局 2027 文憑試重要日期
考評局 2027 文憑試時間表
日校考生達資助學士一般要求（332A＋兩科選修 3 級）
label.en: of day-school candidates met the UGC general requirement (332A + two electives at Level 3)

foot.zh: 約 15,000 個資助學士學額

label.zh: 日校考生達副學位最低要求（五科 2 級，包括中英文）
label.en: of day-school candidates met the sub-degree minimum (five subjects at Level 2 incl. Chinese and English)

label.zh: 每年資助學士高年級學額（副學位畢業生升讀）
label.en: UGC senior-year places a year for sub-degree graduates

foot.zh: 約為副學位入學人數的五分之一（推算）
foot.en: Roughly one per five sub-degree entrants (derived)

text.zh: 2027/28 學年起，以就業或入境計劃簽證來港者不再視為本地學生；受養人簽證持有人須在課程開始前已在港居住滿 1 年（2028/29 起為 2 年），否則須繳付較高學費，並影響各項資助資格。
text.en: From 2027/28, students on employment or talent-scheme visas no longer count as local. Dependant-visa holders need 1 year of residence before their programme starts (2 years from 2028/29), or they pay higher fees and may lose subsidies.

advice.zh: JUPAS 仍是首選；未獲理想取錄時，自資或資助自資學士、內地及海外都可考慮。
advice.en: JUPAS is still your main route. If the offer disappoints, look at self-financed or SSSDP degrees, the Mainland or overseas.

label.zh: 達 332A，但選修未達兩科 3 級

condition.zh: 中文 3、英文 3、數學 2、公民達標

advice.zh: 可報讀自資學士（部分選修要求較低）及內地免試；想讀資助學士，可經副學士升讀高年級。
advice.en: Self-financed degrees (some need lower electives) and the Mainland scheme are open. For a UGC degree, go via an associate degree to senior-year entry.

condition.zh: 五科 2 級，包括中英文
condition.en: Five subjects at Level 2 incl. Chinese and English

advice.zh: 副學士或高級文憑是主要路線。目標讀學位就揀副學士，並以第一年 GPA 3.3 以上為目標；目標就業則揀高級文憑。
advice.en: Associate degree or higher diploma is the main route. Aim for a degree? Choose an AD and target a first-year GPA of 3.3+. Aim for a job? Choose an HD.

condition.zh: 中英文或其他科目未達 2 級
condition.en: Chinese, English or other subjects below Level 2

advice.zh: 應用教育文憑（一年）完成後等同五科 2 級，可升讀副學位；亦可考慮 VTC 基礎文憑或重考個別科目。
advice.en: The one-year Diploma of Applied Education counts as five Level 2 passes for sub-degree entry. VTC's foundation diploma or retaking a few subjects are alternatives.

title.zh: 自資學士（包括資助自資學士 SSSDP）

tagline.zh: 與資助學士同屬資歷架構第 5 級
tagline.en: Same QF Level 5 as UGC degrees

value.zh: 一般為 332A 加選修，按院校而定。
value.en: Usually 332A plus electives, varying by institution.

value.zh: 四年（銜接學位兩年）
value.en: Four years (two for top-up degrees)
e.g. HKMU 2027/28 HK$85,340–123,740 a year; HSUHK 2026/27 Year 1 HK$93,230 (before subsidies).

value.zh: SSSDP 每年最高 HK$81,450（實驗室）／HK$46,780（非實驗室）；非 SSSDP 可獲免入息審查資助 HK$35,120（2026/27）；另有入息審查的學費助學金及免入息審查貸款。
value.en: SSSDP up to HK$81,450 (lab) / HK$46,780 (non-lab) a year; otherwise the non-means-tested subsidy of HK$35,120 (2026/27); plus means-tested grants and non-means-tested loans.

value.zh: SSSDP 一年級學額經 JUPAS；其他課程經 E-APP 或直接向院校申請。
value.en: SSSDP first-year places via JUPAS; others via E-APP or directly.

pitfalls.zh: 扣除資助後，每年仍要自付約 HK$50,000–90,000。
pitfalls.en: Even after subsidy, expect to pay about HK$50,000–90,000 a year.

pitfalls.zh: 副學位及自資課程的留位費約在放榜後一星期截止，早於 JUPAS 正式遴選；退款條件各院校不同。
pitfalls.en: Deposits fall due about a week after results, before JUPAS offers; refund rules vary.

tagline.zh: 兩年，之後可申請升讀學士高年級
tagline.en: Two years, then apply for senior-year degree entry

value.zh: 五科 2 級，包括中英文。
value.en: Five subjects at Level 2 including Chinese and English.

value.zh: 副學士偏重通識，升學選擇較多；高級文憑最少六成屬職業內容，較適合目標明確、想就業的同學。
value.en: ADs are broader and keep more degree options open; at least 60% of an HD is vocational, suiting students with a clear career goal.
e.g. PolyU HKCC 2026/27 HK$151,500–164,125 for the whole programme.

value.zh: 指定課程設 SSSDP 資助，每年 HK$40,730／HK$23,390；另有學費助學金及貸款。
value.en: Designated programmes get SSSDP HK$40,730 / HK$23,390 a year; grants and loans also apply.

value.zh: 每年約 5,000 個資助學士高年級學額，另有約 8,300 個自資銜接學額（2026/27）。GPA 3.0 只是門檻，3.3 以上才較有機會，熱門課程要 3.7–4.0。
value.en: About 5,000 UGC senior-year places a year plus about 8,300 self-financed top-up places (2026/27). GPA 3.0 is only the floor; 3.3+ is realistic and popular programmes want 3.7–4.0.

pitfalls.zh: 院校公布的「升學率」通常包括自資、銜接及海外學位。例如 HKCC 2025 年升學率 90.4%，當中升讀資助學士高年級的只有 53.2%。
pitfalls.en: Published 'articulation rates' usually include self-financed, top-up and overseas degrees. HKCC's 2025 rate was 90.4%, but only 53.2% went to UGC senior-year places.

pitfalls.zh: 第二年上學期已要申請升學，所以主要看第一年 GPA。
pitfalls.en: You apply early in Year 2, so your Year 1 GPA does most of the work.

pitfalls.zh: 部分學士課程仍會看文憑試個別科目成績。
pitfalls.en: Some degree programmes still check specific DSE subject grades.

title.zh: VTC 高級文憑／基礎文憑

value.zh: 高級文憑：中英文 2 級及另外三科 2 級；基礎文憑：完成中六。
value.en: HD: Chinese 2, English 2 and three more subjects at Level 2. Foundation diploma: completion of S6.

value.zh: 資助高級文憑每期 HK$17,570；基礎文憑全年 HK$22,820（2026/27）。
value.en: Subvented HD HK$17,570 per instalment; foundation diploma HK$22,820 for the year (2026/27).

value.zh: 資助高級文憑可申請學生資助及生活費貸款。
value.en: Subvented HDs qualify for student finance and living-expense loans.
2027/28 details are announced in November 2026.

pitfalls.zh: 基礎文憑只令你有資格申請高級文憑，並不保證取錄。
pitfalls.en: The foundation diploma only makes you eligible to apply for an HD; it does not guarantee a place.

pitfalls.zh: 醫療、工程等範疇，須先確認課程獲相關註冊局或專業團體認可。
pitfalls.en: In health care or engineering, check the programme is recognised by the relevant professional body.

title.zh: 應用教育文憑（DAE，取代毅進）

tagline.zh: 一年完成，等同五科 2 級
tagline.en: One year, equivalent to five Level 2 passes

value.zh: 2023/24 學年起取代毅進文憑，屬資歷架構第 3 級；完成後等同文憑試五科 2 級（包括中英文）。
value.en: Replaced Diploma Yi Jin from 2023/24; QF Level 3, equivalent to five HKDSE Level 2 passes including Chinese and English.

value.zh: 合格且出席率達八成可獲退還三成學費；通過入息審查可獲退還全數或一半。
value.en: 30% refunded for a pass with 80% attendance; 100% or 50% for students passing the means test.

pitfalls.zh: 完成後只能升讀副學位，距離學位最少再多三年。
pitfalls.en: It leads only to sub-degree study, adding at least three years before a degree.

title.zh: 以自修生身分重考文憑試
title.en: Retake the HKDSE as a private candidate

tagline.zh: 適合只差一兩科、自律性高的同學

value.zh: 2027 年自修生報名於 2026 年 10 月 7 日截止，10 月 14 日前繳費。
value.en: 2027 private-candidate registration closes 7 Oct 2026; pay by 14 Oct.

value.zh: 基本費 HK$619；中文或英文每科 HK$808，其他每科 HK$540。
value.en: HK$619 base fee; HK$808 each for Chinese or English, HK$540 per other subject.

value.zh: 2025 年重考生中，約 2% 達 332A22；中文及數學由 3 級以下升至 3 級或以上的比率約四成，英文只有約兩成。
value.en: In 2025 about 2% of retakers reached 332A22; around 40% of Chinese and Maths retakers rose to Level 3+, but only about 20% in English.

pitfalls.zh: 院校會看到所有年份的成績，部分課程對合併成績或重考生扣分。
pitfalls.en: Institutions see all sittings; some programmes deduct marks for combined results or repeaters.

pitfalls.zh: 重考前先找出失手的真正原因；原因未解決，重考很難進步。
pitfalls.en: Identify why you missed first; without fixing that, a retake rarely helps.

title.zh: 內地升學（免試收生計劃）

value.zh: 最低 332A；理工醫等專業另有指定科目要求。
value.en: Minimum 332A; science, engineering and medicine majors require specific subjects.
Register before the exam: 1–31 Dec 2025 for 2026/27; 2027/28 not yet published.
RMB 4,500–8,000 a year.
MUSSS: means-tested full rate HK$17,700–19,400 a year; non-means-tested HK$5,900–6,500 (2026/27).

pitfalls.zh: 社工、護理、法律、獸醫等專業與香港沒有互認；醫科畢業生須考香港執業試。
pitfalls.en: Social work, nursing, law and vet degrees are not mutually recognised; medics must pass HK's licensing exam.

pitfalls.zh: 剔選「服從調劑」較易獲取錄，但可能被編到冷門專業。
pitfalls.en: Agreeing to reassignment raises your chance but may land you in an unpopular major.

title.zh: 台灣升學（港澳生聯合招生）

value.zh: 考試前報名；2027 年日期未公布，2026 年聯合分發為 2026 年 2 月 1 日–3 月 15 日，報名費新台幣 2,000 元。
value.en: Register before the exam; 2027 dates not yet published. For 2026, joint distribution ran 1 Feb–15 Mar 2026, fee NT$2,000.

value.zh: 中英數各乘 1.3，另計最佳兩科選修。
value.en: Chinese, English and Maths ×1.3, plus the best two electives.

pitfalls.zh: 正式最低成績要求及學費以台灣官方公布為準。
pitfalls.en: Check the official minimum requirement and fees with the Taiwan committee.

tagline.zh: 文憑試成績可直接申請

value.zh: 考評局與 UCAS 對照：5 級約等於 A-Level A，555 約等於 AAA。
value.en: HKEAA/UCAS: Level 5 ≈ A-level A; 555 ≈ AAA.

value.zh: UCAS：牛劍及醫科 10 月 15 日，其他 1 月 13 日。
value.en: UCAS: 15 Oct for Oxbridge and medicine, 13 Jan for others.

pitfalls.zh: 持 BN(O) 簽證未獲定居身分者，須繳付海外生學費。
pitfalls.en: BN(O) visa holders without settled status pay international fees.

pitfalls.zh: 放榜後才申請，要預留時間辦理學生簽證及資金證明。
pitfalls.en: Applying after results leaves little time for the student visa and proof of funds.

tagline.zh: 適用於持其他學歷或副學位的申請人
tagline.en: For other qualifications or sub-degree holders

value.zh: 只持文憑試成績的本地學生必須經 JUPAS 報讀資助學士；Non-JUPAS 適用於持 IB、A-Level 等其他學歷或副學位的申請人。
value.en: Local applicants with only HKDSE results must use JUPAS; Non-JUPAS is for IB, A-level or sub-degree holders.

pitfalls.zh: 同一年不可同時經 JUPAS 及 Non-JUPAS 報讀同一課程，兩者都可能被拒。
pitfalls.en: You cannot use both routes for the same programme in one year; both may be rejected.

title.zh: 應用學位（職業專才教育學位）

tagline.en: Under SSSDP with a higher subsidy

value.en: Up to HK$89,620 (lab) / HK$51,880 (non-lab) a year; 16 programmes in 2026/27.

value.zh: 與其他 SSSDP 學位相同；例如 VTC／THEi 要求中文 3、英文 3、數學 2、一科選修 2 級及公民達標。
value.en: As for other SSSDP degrees, e.g. VTC/THEi: Chinese 3, English 3, Maths 2, one elective at Level 2 and CSD Attained.

pitfalls.zh: 確認課程獲相關行業或專業團體認可。
pitfalls.en: Check the programme is recognised by the relevant industry or professional body.

what.zh: 見升學老師；如有需要，即日到副學位院校即場報名及面試。
what.en: See your careers teacher; if needed, apply and interview on the spot at sub-degree colleges.

what.zh: 修改 JUPAS 課程選擇（一次免費）。
what.en: Modify your JUPAS choices (one free change).

what.zh: 副學位及自資課程要求繳交留位費（約 HK$5,000 或首期學費），早於 JUPAS 結果公布。
what.en: Sub-degree and self-financed programmes ask for a deposit (about HK$5,000 or the first instalment), before JUPAS results.

what.zh: JUPAS 正式遴選結果；接受須於 8 月 5 日前繳交 HK$5,000。
what.en: JUPAS Main Round results; pay HK$5,000 by 5 Aug to accept.

what.zh: 立即向已繳費的副學位院校申請退還留位費，並在限期前遞交證明。
what.en: Claim back the sub-degree deposit at once, with proof, before the deadline.

what.zh: 未獲正式遴選取錄者的補選結果；在此之前保留副學位學額。
what.en: Clearing results for those without an offer; keep your sub-degree place until then.

refundRules.zh: 一般只有獲 JUPAS 資助學士或 SSSDP 課程取錄，才可申請退還副學位留位費。
refundRules.en: Deposits are generally refundable only if you get a JUPAS offer for a UGC-funded or SSSDP programme.

refundRules.zh: 須自行在限期前申請，並附上接受取錄及註冊證明。
refundRules.en: You must apply yourself before the deadline, with proof of acceptance and registration.

refundRules.zh: 申請費（約 HK$100–500）一概不退。
refundRules.en: Application fees (about HK$100–500) are never refunded.

refundRules.zh: 每間院校的留位費分開繳付，退款條件亦各有不同，報名前先查清楚。
refundRules.en: Each institution's deposit is separate and refund rules differ; check before applying.

adQuestions.zh: 畢業生升讀「資助學士」的比率是多少？不要只看總升學率。
adQuestions.en: What share of graduates reached UGC-funded degrees, not just the headline rate?

adQuestions.zh: 這個課程的畢業生，實際升讀了哪些學士課程？
adQuestions.en: Which degree programmes did this programme's graduates actually enter?

adQuestions.zh: 獲取錄升學的同學，GPA 大約多少？是否按比例評分？
adQuestions.en: What GPA did successful graduates have? Is grading on a curve?

adQuestions.zh: 所謂「保證銜接」是否只限自資銜接學位？
adQuestions.en: Is any 'guaranteed articulation' only a self-financed top-up?

adQuestions.zh: 高級文憑是否獲相關註冊局或專業團體認可？
adQuestions.en: Is the higher diploma recognised by the relevant registration board or professional body?

adQuestions.zh: 兩年總費用多少？可申請哪些資助及貸款？
adQuestions.en: What is the two-year total cost, and what grants and loans apply?

adQuestions.zh: 何時計算第一年 GPA？第二年何時申請升學？
adQuestions.en: When is Year 1 GPA assessed, and when do you apply for degrees in Year 2?

retakeCheck.zh: 我能清楚說出失手的原因，而且有具體改善方法。
retakeCheck.en: I can name why I missed and have a concrete fix.

retakeCheck.zh: 我只差一兩科，而不是全面落後。
retakeCheck.en: I am short in one or two subjects, not across the board.

retakeCheck.zh: 我能在沒有學校督促下，自律溫習一整年。
retakeCheck.en: I can study on my own for a year without school structure.

retakeCheck.zh: 我明白院校會看到兩年成績，而目標課程接受合併成績。
retakeCheck.en: I understand institutions see both years and my target programmes accept combined results.

retakeCheck.zh: 我已考慮一邊讀副學位、一邊重考個別科目的做法。
retakeCheck.en: I have considered studying a sub-degree while retaking a subject.

myth.zh: 副學士升學率 90%，即是有九成機會升讀大學。
myth.en: A 90% articulation rate means a 90% chance of a university place.

fact.zh: 升學率包括自資、銜接及海外學位。以 HKCC 為例，升讀資助學士高年級的只有 53.2%。
fact.en: It includes self-financed, top-up and overseas degrees. At HKCC only 53.2% went to UGC senior-year places.

myth.en: GPA 3.0 is enough for a degree.

fact.zh: 3.0 只是門檻，3.3 以上才較有機會，熱門課程要 3.7–4.0。
fact.en: 3.0 is the floor; 3.3+ is realistic and popular programmes want 3.7–4.0.

myth.zh: 讀咗副學士，文憑試成績就不再重要。
myth.en: Once in an AD, DSE results no longer matter.

fact.zh: 部分學士課程仍設文憑試科目要求，例如港大個別主修要求中文 5 級。
fact.en: Some degrees still set DSE subject requirements, e.g. Chinese Level 5 for some HKU majors.

fact.zh: 自資學士與資助學士同屬資歷架構第 5 級，分別在於學費及部分僱主觀感。
fact.en: They are the same QF Level 5; the difference is cost and some employer perception.

myth.zh: 毅進是成績未達五科 2 級的出路。
myth.en: Yi Jin is the route below five Level 2 passes.

fact.zh: 毅進已於 2023/24 由應用教育文憑取代，完成後只能升讀副學位。
fact.en: Yi Jin was replaced by the DAE in 2023/24, which leads only to sub-degrees.

myth.zh: 內地學位可在香港從事任何專業。
myth.en: A Mainland degree lets me practise any profession in Hong Kong.

fact.zh: 社工、護理、法律、獸醫沒有互認；醫科須考香港執業試。
fact.en: Social work, nursing, law and vet are not recognised; medicine needs the licensing exam.

myth.zh: 接受 JUPAS Band E，讀一年再重新報 JUPAS 就可以。
myth.en: Accept a Band E offer, study a year, then re-apply through JUPAS.

fact.zh: 正在修讀 JUPAS 學士課程的同學，須先完成退學手續才可再次申請。
fact.en: Students enrolled in a JUPAS degree must withdraw before re-applying.

myth.zh: 副學位留位費拿到 JUPAS 取錄就一定可以退。
myth.en: Sub-degree deposits are always refunded once I get a JUPAS offer.

fact.zh: 一般只限資助學士或 SSSDP 取錄，並須在限期前自行申請；申請費不退。
fact.en: Usually only for UGC or SSSDP offers, you must claim before the deadline, and application fees are never refunded.
